items.title: Bluey: Mini Bluey and Bluey Toy Box Set
items.description: Snuggle up with your very own cuddly Bluey toy as you read this funny story! Bluey colours Bingo to be more like her. They have so much fun being each other - but does Dad really want double Bingos instead? This adorable book and plush toy gift set includes- * One Mini Bluey storybook * One soft and cuddly Bluey plush toy It's the perfect gift for little Bluey fans - bringing storytime and playtime together! Based on the hit ABC KIDS TV show! Bluey is an award-winning preschool series about a blue heeler pup and her family. Airing on ABC KIDS, the show has captured the hearts of families everywhere with its beloved books, toys, clothes, games and more.
